From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@novumcloud.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, procurement@novumcloud.com
Cc: andrew.chen@novumcloud.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan and exec sponsor availability for Novum eval

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from procurement and the CIO's office — we're trying to lock the evaluation and approval timeline for Redwood's platform. High level: Novum wants a short MAP that ties technical evaluation steps to procurement milestones and an EB (executive briefing) where our CIO (Andrew) and legal/procurement will join. Target close window is end of June.

Can you: 1) share a draft MAP and proposed EB dates (we prefer early June), 2) call out required attendees on both sides, and 3) confirm if you can surface SOC 2 and data residency info before the EB?

We need the MAP and a calendar hold this week to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Leah Turner
Program Manager, Strategic Sourcing
Novum Cloud

Attachments: None (we pulled the high-level SOW from your website)
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@novumcloud.com>
Cc: Novum Cloud Procurement <procurement@novumcloud.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and exec sponsor availability for Novum eval

Leah —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attaching a first-pass MAP and an evaluation checklist for your team to review.

Quick summary / proposed approach:
- MAP: three lanes (Technical eval, Procurement/legal, Executive briefings) with owners and target dates.
- EB: propose two candidate windows — June 1 (Wed) 10:00–11:00 PT or June 7 (Tue) 10:00–11:00 PT. Recommend June 7 if you need additional time for legal.
- Required attendees (Novum): CIO or delegated exec sponsor, technical champion (SRE/ML engineer), procurement lead. (Redwood): VP Sales (Marissa Cole), Technical Lead (TBD), Account Exec (me).
- SOC 2 / compliance: I can share the SOC 2 summary and our data residency/retention doc by EOD Monday.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm preferred EB window, 2) we finalize MAP owners & dates, 3) Redwood provides SOC2 summary and draft contract redlines for procurement review.

I'm attaching: Draft_MAP_Novum_v1.xlsx, Evaluation_Steps.docx (stubs attached below).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments:
- Draft_MAP_Novum_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; MAP lanes & milestones)
- Evaluation_Steps.docx (doc; suggested technical checks and acceptance criteria)

To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@novumcloud.com>, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@novumcloud.com

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and exec sponsor availability for Novum eval

Leah / Rafael —

Looping in a more detailed milestone set so procurement and your technical team can map owners. I created a simple CSV output that mirrors the MAP spreadsheet with concrete dates; attaching MAP_milestones.csv. Key highlights:

- Week of May 24: Canary demo + base performance run (owner: Redwood SE — demo env)
- May 27: Tech deep-dive & scoring rubric delivered (owner: Novum technical champion)
- Jun 1–7: EB window (preferred: Jun 7) — exec sponsor alignment and contract gating
- Jun 14: Procurement redlines received / commercial commit target
- Jun 30: Target production acceptance (final close)

Mutual action items (short):
- Redwood: provide SOC 2 summary, sample contract redlines, and canary demo link (target May 21–24).
- Novum: confirm technical champion contact and allocate procurement reviewer for June 14 review.

If June 7 is feasible for EB, we'll lock the slot and request your exec sponsor name/email so we can send a formal calendar invite and prep deck.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments:
